gameName: The Crew: The Quest for Planet Nine

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: The Crew: The Quest for Planet Nine rulebook (KOSMOS, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Shuffle the 40 large cards and deal them all out facedown, evenly
steps.note: 3 players: one gets an extra card, which stays unplayed after the last trick

steps.text: Each player: a radio communication token green side up and a reminder card
Shuffle the 36 small task cards facedown
Reveal the tasks the mission calls for in the middle
Whoever holds the rocket 4 announces it and is the captain
From the captain clockwise, pick task cards until all are taken
The captain opens the first trick
